messages.subject: reversing height_0.95_HPD with revts() and tree_theme2()
messages.subject_clean: reversing height_0.95_HPD with revts() and tree_theme2()
messages.body_plain:
Hi Everyone,

I realize there have been a few posts on this topic, HERE <https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/bioc-ggtree/height_0.95_HPD%7Csort:date/bioc-ggtree/4DdgTc1ZL2U/65P6dWYLAwAJ> for example, but I still haven't seen an answer that works for my problem. I am plotting a time-calibrated BEAST2 tree with `height_0.95_HPD` values at the nodes. I am reversing the axis using `revts()`. When I do this, the x-axis reverses, but the height_0.95_HPD values do not reverse. See reproducible example below. If you look closely you can see that the node height values do not reverse.

I realize that this may be tricky, but does anyone know how to "reverse" the height_0.95_HPD values before or during plotting?

Thank you very much!
Jon

example 1

mac, ggtree version 1.14.6
library(ggtree)

file <- system.file("extdata/BEAST", "beast_mcc.tree", package="treeio")

beast <- read.beast(file)

ggtr <- ggtree(beast) + theme_tree2()  +   geom_range(range='height_0.95_HPD', color='red', alpha=.3, branch.length="height", size = 3)

ggtr

example 2
ggtr2 <- revts(ggtr)

ggtr2

example 3
ggtr3 <- ggtree(beast)

ggtr3.1 <- revts(ggtr3)

ggtr3.2 <- ggtr3.1 +  theme_tree2()  +   geom_range(range='height_0.95_HPD', color='red', alpha=.3, branch.length="height", size = 3)

ggtr3.2

messages.subject_clean: phangorn, msa and ggtree phylogenetic tree building, error at phyPML() function
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am trying to build a phylogenetic tree of ~1000 nodes with msa, phangorn and ggtree packages.

I aligned my sequences with msa:msaMuscle(), then run some phangorn package code get optim.pml fit object and then plot it with ggtree. At the line:
